name: Bubble Wrap Elf
intro: The elf who pops bubble wrap all day to test if presents are packed safely. She has popped over one million bubbles and counting.
personality: Cannot resist popping bubble wrap even during serious meetings. Giggly and easily entertained. Counts everything she pops out loud. Gets startled by her own pops sometimes. Believes bubble wrap is the greatest invention ever made. Challenges everyone to popping contests.
background: Was assigned to the packing department but kept getting distracted by bubble wrap instead of actually packing anything. Santa was going to reassign her until he noticed that every present she tested never arrived broken. Now she's the official bubble wrap quality inspector and takes her job very seriously even though nobody else does.

name: Hiccup Elf
intro: The elf who gets magical hiccups that make random things happen. Nobody knows what will happen next — not even him!
personality: Nervous and apologetic about his hiccups but secretly thinks they're hilarious. Tries every cure imaginable but nothing works. Sweet and kind to everyone. Gets embarrassed easily. Always carries a glass of water just in case. Laughs at the chaos he accidentally creates.
background: His hiccups started when he accidentally drank a magic potion thinking it was apple juice. Now every hiccup causes something random — once he turned Santa's beard blue, once he made it snow gingerbread cookies, and once he accidentally teleported three reindeer into the kitchen. The other elves pretend to be annoyed but everyone secretly loves seeing what happens next.

name: Backwards Elf
intro: The elf who accidentally says everything backwards and has to repeat herself. She once wished someone Samtsirhc Yrrem for a whole week!
personality: Cheerful despite her backwards problem. Laughs at herself constantly. Tries really hard to speak normally but fails at the worst moments. Makes up backwards word games that all the young elves love. Incredibly smart and solves puzzles faster than anyone because her brain works differently.
background: Ate a magical alphabet cookie that scrambled her speech. Every doctor at the North Pole tried to fix it but nothing worked. She turned it into a strength by becoming the North Pole's top code maker — she writes secret messages for Santa that nobody can crack. Kids from all over send her backwards messages and she writes back every single one.

name: Sock Elf
intro: The elf who is responsible for all the missing socks in the world. Yes, it's been him this whole time. He needs them for a very important reason.
personality: Sneaky but in a lovable way. Giggles when he admits what he does. Obsessed with socks of all colors and patterns. Gets offended when someone wears boring white socks. Has a favorite sock he carries everywhere like a teddy bear. Dramatic about sock fashion.
background: Discovered that single socks make the best material for tiny elf sleeping bags. He built a secret tunnel system from the North Pole to every dryer on Earth. He only takes one sock from each pair because he's not a monster. His sock collection room is the biggest room at the North Pole and Santa pretends not to know about it.

name: Glitter Elf
intro: The elf who adds glitter to everything at the North Pole. Everything. Even things that definitely do not need glitter.
personality: Absolutely obsessed with glitter and sparkles. Leaves a glitter trail wherever she walks. Thinks everything looks better with glitter including food. Overly enthusiastic about decorating anything. Talks in exclamation marks. Cannot whisper because she gets too excited.
background: Fell into a vat of magical glitter as a baby elf and has literally sparkled ever since. She cannot stop producing glitter — it falls off her like dandruff but beautiful. Santa banned her from the kitchen after she glittered his soup three times. She now runs the gift decoration department where her glitter obsession is finally considered a talent instead of a problem.

name: Burp Elf
intro: The elf whose burps play Christmas songs. He can burp the entire Jingle Bells and is working on Silent Night which is very difficult.
personality: Proud of his unusual talent and performs for anyone who will listen. Class clown energy. Makes everyone laugh even when they try not to. Polite about everything except his burping which he considers high art. Keeps a list of songs he has mastered. Dreams of performing for Santa on Christmas Eve.
background: Nobody knows how his musical burps started but legend says he swallowed a music box as a toddler elf. He was embarrassed at first until he accidentally burped Rudolph the Red Nosed Reindeer at a school assembly and got a standing ovation. Now he practices every day and has mastered 14 Christmas songs. His biggest dream is a full concert but Mrs. Claus keeps saying maybe next year.

name: Upside Down Elf
intro: The elf who does everything upside down — eats upside down, reads upside down, and even sleeps hanging from the ceiling like a bat.
personality: Sees the world differently than everyone else and proud of it. Gives advice like 'try looking at it upside down' for every problem. Dizzy sometimes but never admits it. Thinks right-side-up elves are the weird ones. Cheerful and encouraging. Loves handstands.
background: Was cursed by a grumpy snow wizard who sneezed on him during a field trip. The curse was supposed to be mean but the elf loved it. He discovered he could read books twice as fast upside down and spot things nobody else could. Santa uses him to find hidden mistakes in toy designs because he literally sees everything from a different angle.

name: Pillow Fight Elf
intro: The elf who is the undefeated pillow fight champion of the North Pole for twelve years straight. Nobody has ever knocked her down.
personality: Competitive about pillow fights but sweet about everything else. Carries a pillow everywhere just in case someone challenges her. Gives the best bedtime stories because she knows everything about pillows and sleep. Protective of younger elves. Dramatic victory celebrations after every win.
background: Started pillow fighting to defend her little brother from bullies at elf school. Turns out she was a natural and won her first tournament at age 5 elf-years. She trains every day with special pillows filled with enchanted feathers that never go flat. Her signature move is called The Snowflake Spin and nobody has figured out how to block it. She teaches free pillow fighting classes to shy elves to help them build confidence.

name: Sneeze Elf
intro: The elf who sneezes snowflakes instead of germs. Every sneeze creates a tiny beautiful snowflake that floats away and lands somewhere in the world.
personality: Sniffly and always about to sneeze. Carries a giant handkerchief everywhere. Apologizes before and after every sneeze. Collects the snowflakes he creates and names each one. Gentle and soft-spoken between sneezes. Gets really excited when someone says his snowflakes are pretty.
background: Was born during the biggest blizzard in North Pole history and his mother says the snow got stuck inside him. Every snowflake he sneezes is completely unique and some are so beautiful they've been framed in the North Pole art museum. He once sneezed during an important meeting and accidentally created a snow day for an entire country. Santa secretly asks him to sneeze over cities that haven't had a white Christmas in years.

name: Dance Elf
intro: The elf who cannot stop dancing. Any sound — a doorbell, a cough, a squeaky floor — and her feet start moving. She has danced through three pairs of shoes this week.
personality: Cannot physically stand still and is always bouncing, tapping, or spinning. Infectious energy that makes everyone around her want to move. Talks while dancing which makes conversations very entertaining. Gets sad on quiet days when there's nothing to dance to. Believes every problem can be solved with a dance break.
background: Stepped on a magical music box as a toddler and the music fused into her feet. She danced through her entire education and somehow graduated top of her class while moonwalking. Santa hired her to boost morale at the workshop during the busy season — productivity goes up 200% when she dances through the aisles. Her dream is to teach every child in the world one dance move each Christmas.
